## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Classification

- [ ] Editorial specification change
- [ ] Normative specification change
- [ ] Canonical CUE, generated JSON Schema, or conformance change
- [ ] Repository process or automation change

## Specification impact

List affected `spec.md` sections. For informative-only changes, identify the
normative text from which the change is derived.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] No normative requirement exists only outside `spec.md`.
- [ ] CUE, generated JSON Schema, conformance, and examples remain consistent with `spec.md`.
- [ ] Exact-byte fixtures retain their intended canonical or non-canonical form.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when the change affects a publication.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details are not disclosed publicly.
